intent: Conform the Cafe Le Den customer and admin UI to the canonical DX design contract while preserving ordering, authentication, data, pricing, tax, internationalization, and state semantics.

applied_fixes.title: Create redirects are swallowed as save failures
Pending saves can clear newer draft edits
Undo can repopulate a completed order cart
Order recovery link targets a missing route
Analytics retry evidence targets a no-op
Checkout success path lacks deterministic characterization
verification: EN/FR payload, tax, confirmation, and cart-clear assertions

applied_fixes.title: New Buttons rely on implicit variants or sizes
Manifest omits shared modified admin components

residual_actionable_work.title: Order rejections prescribe an unsafe retry
residual_actionable_work.next_step: Map the existing API error strings to localized hours, menu-change, service, price-change, and partial-write recovery without changing the API response shape or exposing raw server text.

residual_actionable_work.title: Mutation gate passes without testing a mutation
residual_actionable_work.next_step: Keep the placeholder visibly skipped until a seeded non-production Supabase target exists, then replace it with authenticated synthetic mutations and deterministic cleanup.

residual_actionable_work.title: Sign-out runs before the draft guard
residual_actionable_work.next_step: Coordinate the shared sign-out action with active unsaved-change guards before clearing authentication.

residual_actionable_work.title: Navigation guard cannot cancel some history traversals
residual_actionable_work.next_step: Define and test a Back/Forward strategy for non-cancelable Navigation API events and browser fallback paths.

residual_actionable_work.title: Filter changes leave a pending search debounce active
residual_actionable_work.next_step: Cancel the pending search timer before an immediate date or status navigation, then assert that only one route transition occurs.

advisory_only.title: Real cafe data needs owner authority before launch
Static analytics preview can drift from the production renderer

residual_risks: The approved visual-refactor boundary leaves Supabase-returned analytics and order-history query errors represented as empty data unless a query throws.
Authenticated admin mutations remain intentionally unverified without a seeded non-production Supabase target.
Build-backed tests must remain serialized because concurrent Next build writers previously corrupted .next output.

agent_native.summary: No agent or LLM integration exists, and each newly visible action remains backed by the existing programmatic action, store, fetch, or API primitive.

learnings: Keep Server Component link styling in the server-safe button-variants module.
Serialize production builds and Playwright because the shared .next directory is not safe for concurrent writers.
Preserve the sample-data authority gate as launch work rather than presenting fallback content as owner-approved.

coverage.validator_reject_reason: Open-status direct ramp usage is allowed tone-based brand composition; state-dependent dot classes predate this diff.
over_budget_items: Checkout recovery flag has no reachable true state
Menu status metadata includes an unused dot API
